competition_history: Miraidon-S was not located as a NIST or NGCC submission; MIRA and MiRitH merged as the distinct Mirath candidate, and CROSS is a distinct scheme.
attack_technique: Use the all-zero MinRank coefficient vector and rank-zero factorization because the verifier accepts Q=LR without enforcing a nonzero or exact-rank witness.
related_prior_techniques: standard missing-membership and zero-witness checks in identification protocols
conditions: Use the evident correction of Algorithm 6's swapped c0 Merkle-root and c1 flat-aggregate checks; the printed ordering is otherwise not executable on honest signatures.
independent_reproduction_scope: The checked-in independent all-row standard-library implementation forged and verified two fresh messages at each Level I, III, and V row and confirmed that exact-rank validation blocks the attack; a second independent Level-I reconstruction also passed.
verification_basis: Passed technical, adversarial, independent-reproduction, history, and publication-review gates
